steps.subject: sky
steps.action: warm the top with a little cad yellow
steps.load: tiny amount on the large brush
steps.rule: warm colors keep the winter scene from feeling too cold

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend yellow ochre into the yellow
steps.motion: blend together with a little movement

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend bright red into the warm colors

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add a little blue and black at the top

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: dab a bashful floater cloud with white
steps.load: lots of paint on the bristles

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend the cloud with the blender

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: tap tiny clouds in a brownish mix
steps.motion: tiny circles with the fan corner

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: highlight the clouds with a pinkish color
steps.load: least liquid white added to thin
steps.rule: liquid white keeps the color from mixing into the brush

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: tap in a soft far hill with white and brown
steps.load: brown from crimson and sap green plus white
steps.motion: tap in color, then lift upward

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: blend the far hill base into mist
steps.motion: tap and blend the base out

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: add a foothill with the brown mix
steps.where: middle canvas, right of the far hill

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: add tiny far trees in layers, farthest first
steps.motion: tap with the corner and lift
steps.rule: paint the farthest layer first to create depth

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: add a darker layer of trees
steps.rule: closer layers should be darker in value to read as closer

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: sneak snow up through the layers

steps.subject: land
steps.action: add warm red touches low on the canvas
steps.rule: sky colors should show down low too

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: paint big evergreen with the corner, pushing harder down
steps.motion: push harder going down the tree
steps.rule: pushing bends the bristles down for this kind of tree

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: add two smaller evergreens beside the big one

steps.subject: other: shadow under tree
steps.action: pull white for a tree shadow
steps.motion: pull a stroke under the tree
steps.rule: pulling creates a shadow under the tree

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: highlight the tree on the lit side
steps.motion: indicate highlights along the light side
steps.rule: thin paint sticks to thick paint

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: darken the lower trees

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: scrape out a basic cabin shape
steps.where: scraping removes excess paint so the next layer sticks

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: add dark brown back eave

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: add brown and white boards on the front

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: add old wood texture with the small knife
steps.load: roll of the brown and white
steps.where: cabin face, darker on one side

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: add board lines with dark paint

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: outline the roof edges with white
steps.rule: outlining straight edges is easy and it works well

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: add snow on the roof with a blue and white edge
steps.load: white with a little blue on the edge
steps.rule: blue edge makes the snow look deeper

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: add a door with dark and a light edge

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: push brown bushes up around the cabin
steps.load: brown from the sap green and crimson

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add yellow ochre and bright red highlights
steps.load: liquid white on the brush, yellow ochre added
steps.motion: pull in one direction, turn, highlight

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add a small tree with a thin brush
steps.motion: twist to a point and add arms

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: pull bush color down for snow shadows

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: scratch sticks and twigs with the knife

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: highlight the tree and project it forward

steps.subject: other: signature
steps.action: sign the painting with red
